blockingFindings.title: R3 pass artifact test cannot exercise pass contract
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires preserved valid-run artifact and transition behavior, but the current spec-local test cannot validly reach a passing scenario-validity run.
blockingFindings.issue: `writeScenarioFixture()` creates `expected-failure.test.js` with tests that always call `assert.fail("implementation is pending")`, yet the R3 test immediately expects `command.execute()` to return `result: "pass"`, `next: "test-review"`, and a pass artifact. This test contradicts its own fixture and the target scenario-validity API behavior, so it cannot provide executable coverage for retained pass artifact/transition behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Use a passing scenario fixture for the pass portion of R3, then introduce the production-target change only for the block portion.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 requires preserved valid-run artifact and transition behavior, but the current spec-local test cannot validly reach a passing scenario-validity run.
blockingFindings.failureKind: test is not executable or clearly contradicts the target API

blockingFindings.title: R4 omits required untracked production change coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement-to-test artifact marks R4 covered, but the actual test omits one of R4's named mandatory coverage classes.
blockingFindings.issue: R4 explicitly requires unit coverage for committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked current-flow changes, but the R4 test only creates committed `src/committed.js`, staged `src/staged.js`, and unstaged tracked files (`tests/retained.test.js`, `package.json`). It does not create or assert any untracked production-target file.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an untracked production-target file to the R4 fixture and assert it appears in `listScenarioValidityPreflightFiles()` output.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement-to-test artifact marks R4 covered, but the actual test omits one of R4's named mandatory coverage classes.
blockingFindings.failureKind: acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage

blockingFindings.title: R4 retained transition assertion encodes block behavior, not pass transition
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement-to-test coverage artifact says R4 covers retained artifact/transition behavior, but the actual test contradicts that coverage by asserting only the block path.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test name and requirement claim coverage for retained pass transition behavior, but the executable assertion expects `outcome.ok === false` and `SCENARIO_VALIDITY_BLOCKED` after creating production-target changes. It never asserts advancement of a pass result to test review.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a pass-path assertion in R4, or remove pass-transition coverage from R4 and rely on a corrected R3 pass-path test.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement-to-test coverage artifact says R4 covers retained artifact/transition behavior, but the actual test contradicts that coverage by asserting only the block path.
blockingFindings.failureKind: requirement coverage artifact contradicts the actual test files
